briefing: Market is neutral today (NASDAQ -0.7%, S&P 500 -0.5%), and while several candidates (FPS, RIG, VAL, DK) score well on RSI/MACD/SMA signals, none show a confirmed volume surge, and the strategy memory advises against forcing buys on neutral days. Holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash in reserve until a genuine risk-on setup (NASDAQ +2% or more) appears.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' or neutral market day is when investors show no strong conviction in either direction, often leading to sideways price action. On days like this, disciplined investors avoid forcing new trades just to deploy cash, instead waiting for clearer signals of strength before committing more capital.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」或中性市況係指投資者對後市方向缺乏明確信心，令股價傾向橫行整理。喺呢種日子，有紀律嘅投資者唔會為咗用盡現金而勉強落飛，反而會耐心等待更清晰嘅強勢訊號先再加碼。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.7% and the S&P 500 down 0.5%, reflecting a broadly neutral, low-conviction trading session rather than any single catalyst-driven move. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, institutional participation appears muted across the screened candidates, none of which showed the volume confirmation typically associated with strong follow-through. This kind of quiet, directionless day is common between larger market-moving events.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍偏軟，納斯達克指數下跌0.7%，標普500指數下跌0.5%，反映市場處於中性、低動能的交易日，並非由單一重大消息驅動。由於缺乏明確嘅風險偏好或避險訊號，篩選出嚟嘅候選股份都未見成交量顯著放大，難以確認機構資金積極參與。呢類波動不大、方向不明嘅交易日喺重大市場事件之間頗為常見。
